recording.lineage: 3 Nakamichi CM300s w/CP4s> Nakamichi MX100 mixer>patchbay>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters No Dolby. Orchestra Floor Sec. R/C Row RR Seat 54 | The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
